meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把代码库梳理成按功能分组的流程图，找出跨功能重复的逻辑，并提出统一架构方案。产出功能清单、流程图、重复报告、统一提案和 /make-plan 交接提示词，不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要求「find the ideal path」、统一重复系统，或在重构前审计架构时触发。它会从功能发现开始，逐步产出图表与方案。

say.text: 帮我把这个代码库画成按功能分组的流程图
say.note: 先给功能清单，再并行画流程图

say.text: 找出这些功能里重复的逻辑，给我一份统一方案
say.note: 输出重复报告和统一架构提案

say.text: 把统一后的每个系统写成 /make-plan 提示词
say.note: 产出可直接复制运行的交接提示词

howto.what_en: Claude maps your codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns across features, and proposes a unified architecture. Outputs a duplication report, a unified proposal, and /make-plan handoff prompts — no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It starts with feature discovery, then produces diagrams and a proposal.

say_en.text: Map this codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts
say_en.note: Feature inventory first, then parallel flowcharts

say_en.text: Find duplicated logic across features and propose one unified design
say_en.note: Outputs a duplication report and unified proposal

say_en.text: Write /make-plan prompts for each unified system
